_doc: CHASE candidates. gross_us = best-supported per-shape layer gain claim in us (positive = faster) at the time of this report; design_us = the original plan/claim; cap_us = documented headroom (profile kernel time minus byte/stream floor, see source). evidence: pre = untimed/design claim, iso = isolated paired A/B gain measured, gate = in-layer ABBA gain measured. checks = additional checks to a scored result. haircut multiplies gross. All inputs are public ledger/profile numbers; none comes from a candidate's judged score.

candidates.name: Dense GEMVs at T=1 (cgemv qkv + unpooler slice)
candidates.status: CHECK 8ffd6871 DONE: adopted 0 (qkv cg+pdl 0.995-1.000 best, un:cg 1.01-1.02 slower)
candidates.change: replace sk2 launches with vjeux cgemv (FP32 reduce, one BF16 round) at T=1 qkv and unpooler slice
candidates.mechanism: higher HBM rate on the 4 dense GEMVs (38 us measured vs 34.9 us byte floor)
candidates.evidence_text: in-layer read-flush ABBA exists (8ffd6871): best arm qkv:cg+pdl S1 0.9991/0.9921, F2 0.9947/0.9991 (~+0.3 us); un:cg 1.012-1.020 slower; design 4.4 us exceeds the 3.2 us documented headroom
candidates.kill: no arm <=0.988 median AND paired in two passes (already hit for every T=1 arm)

candidates.name: VMS MoE engine at T=16 (MID replacement)
candidates.status: iteration 4 DONE (c5800fa6): no arm passes the board gate; Decode wiring (decode_vms.py) not yet checked
candidates.parent: kb v1 MID at M=16 (kb/exp/moe_vms4.py, kb/exp/decode_vms.py)
candidates.change: it1 engine + split-K B + wide finalizer (arm r4+fin2 best); route into decode MoE call at T=16 only
candidates.mechanism: output-owned tiles, B split-K=2, PDL A->B; removes ramp/tail between phases
candidates.evidence_text: board bs16: arm 94-96 us vs incumbent 98.3 (median 0.955-0.981, paired 0.991-1.006, so ~0 to -4 us); mean of both = -2.5 us x (in-layer MoE/board 0.76 S, 0.575 F) = 1.9/1.4 us. Stream-only A 61.1 + B 33.5 us = 94.6 us serialised, i.e. the engine already sits at its phase-stream floor; the 84 us target needs A->B streaming without drain (iteration 2's continuous ring was 2x slower)
candidates.kill: decode gate paired AND median > 0.988 at d16S/d16F in two passes; or MoE-board paired >0.99 on the best arm

candidates.name: NEW: MoE T=128/256 phase-B consumer throughput (cheaper FP4 dequant/MMA issue per value, MAIN consumers)
candidates.status: not built; headroom documented, lever not demonstrated
candidates.change: reduce consumer instruction count per FP4 value in phase B (c967ffa3: consumer-bound, dequant+MMA 66%, ring full 83% of B)
candidates.mechanism: MoE 162-191 us vs read-flush stream floor 131-134 us (f125e6ab BASE/STREAM bs128 182.8/147.3, bs256 227.3/159.5)
candidates.evidence_text: gross = 6% capture prior (best past MoE-MAIN in-layer capture: ERL/HINT/FINREG 0.5-1.7% of MoE, pfy ~2 us of 57) x documented headroom; same-family attempts closed: P2-RS64 1.49x slower, L1 1.03-1.06x, L2 1.03-1.12x, 7bae45c5 tables slower; NODQ ~= BASE in D-MoE diag vs 'dequant removal saves 3.8-6.9%' in c967ffa3 (conflict)
candidates.kill: isolated MAIN consumer A/B (read flush, bs128+bs256, 3 draws) not <=0.98 on both

candidates.name: NEW: FP32-faithful rq/CURP qkv at T=16/32 (fix the BF16 per-split reduce that flips expert ids)
candidates.status: not built; accumulator fix specified by f2ab6d4c root cause
candidates.parent: kb v1 sk2 qkv (kb/exp/decode_curp.py arms Q)
candidates.change: keep rq tiling but reduce split partials in FP32 and round once (as sk2 does), then rerun the Q arms
candidates.mechanism: dense qkv 18.5-21.1 us; documented dense headroom 15-27 us/shape vs byte floor 34.9
candidates.evidence_text: in-layer paired ratios measured (f2ab6d4c d32S 0.985/0.991, d32F 0.991/0.995, d16 0.996-0.998) but with numerics that flip 1.6-2.3% of ids; haircut 0.5 is an ASSUMPTION for the extra FP32 partial traffic (unmeasured)
candidates.kill: ids flip >0 or in-layer ratio > 0.99 at d32S/d32F after the FP32 reduce

candidates.name: NEW: fold/hide the two boundary-glue kernels per layer at T>=16 (pre-wait weight stages + early trigger)
candidates.status: not built; partial PDL variants closed
candidates.parent: kb v1 glue_cluster_boundary x2 (d16) / _graft_row_boundary (d32, v16, v32)
candidates.change: single boundary kernel per layer or PDL early-trigger with 2 pre-wait stages of the next GEMV (the T<=8 recipe, see H200_FACTS)
candidates.mechanism: boundary glue 8.6-13.7 us/shape visible in the profile (d16S 5.4+3.2, d32S 8.7, v16S 9.8, v32S 13.7)
candidates.evidence_text: gross = 24% capture prior (best past glue gain: M16 glue PDL -2.1/-1.8 us of 8.6, p5b) x documented glue time; H200_FACTS: at T<=8 skipping a whole glue launch saves only 1.2-2.0 us because the next GEMV already streams pre-wait; last-CTA/GEMV-tail folds closed (b3e93db2 2x slower, gle8 1.03x slower, sfnfold neutral)
candidates.kill: boundary-only ablation (skip one boundary launch, wrong numerics, timing only) saves <1.5 us at d16/v32 in the layer
